text:
I haven't made any edit, because I only have the path `app/src/handover.ts` and not its contents. Any SEARCH text I wrote would be a guess, and a wrong guess would be refused or change the wrong thing. Rewriting the whole file would risk deleting code I can't see.

To write the change I need to know:

- **The current `Handover.report` method.** I need its exact text, including whether it returns a string joined with `"\n"` or an array of lines, and whether there is a trailing newline.
- **How the timeline is stored.** I need the field name and whether events are kept in the order they were added. Since a gauge reading can carry an earlier time than ticks added before it, I'll take the last three by position in that list and not sort by time.
- **Where `describeEvent` comes from.** I need to know whether it is defined in this file or imported.

Please paste `src/handover.ts`, or just the `Handover` class and the imports at the top. I'll then give you a single exact edit. It will append the last three events, newest first, each through `describeEvent`. It will add fewer lines when there are fewer than three events, and none when there are none. The existing report lines will not change.
